subject.title: fix(tts): allow trusted local media in message_tool_only mode

question: Should `message_tool_only` allow a trusted-local-media-only reply to bypass source-reply suppression when it has verified TTS provenance, while all text and untrusted media remain suppressed?
rationale: This is a core cross-channel visibility and trust contract; tests can prove the selected rule but cannot choose which producer classes may be privileged to deliver after suppression.

options.title: Approve the narrow TTS-only bypass
options.body: Allow the PR after exact-head proof confirms that only trusted, media-bearing TTS payloads bypass suppression and all text is stripped.

options.title: Keep suppression absolute
options.body: Reject this bypass and require TTS auto-delivery to use a separately approved channel-delivery contract instead.

options.title: Broaden the contract deliberately
options.body: Define a documented provenance API for additional trusted media producers before permitting them through the same path.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow TTS-only bypass
recommendation.body: Allow the PR after exact-head proof confirms that only trusted, media-bearing TTS payloads bypass suppression and all text is stripped.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline connects this person to the active review discussion, and the choice is principally an agent/runtime policy decision.
